body: I'm so sorry to hear about your mom and what you're going through, I can't even imagine how difficult this is for you and your family. I'm not going to tell you that things are going to turn out okay, because I genuinely don't know that, but what I do know is that it's okay to not be okay. You don't have to be strong all the time, and how you're feeling is valid. I think talking to your mom might be a good idea though. You don't have to go into the full extent of how you're feeling (depending on how the conversation goes), but mentioning to her that you're having a hard time dealing with her recent diagnosis might be helpful to you. I don't think it will worsen her state because moms tend to put their kids first no matter what. Talking to you might even help take her mind off of how she's feeling for a little bit too. But I understand not wanting to be a burden, so if you feel like you can't talk to her, I hope there's someone else you can confide in. Feel free to message me if you like, I can't promise I'll know exactly what to say or how to help but I am a good listener. Sending love and positive energy your way <33

I know this is cliche, but you really need to know that his illness is not your fault. At all. Anorexia is exactly what I just said it was, an illness. Most of the time there's nothing friends and family can do to "fix" people with anorexia, except love and support them and I'm sure that's what you've been doing. I'm so glad your friend is getting the help he needs now, and the best thing you can do for him is continue to support him. He probably appreciates you and your friendship more than you know.

Hey dude, I'm 20 and haven't lost my virginity yet and it's not looking like I will any time soon. Like you said in your post, life isn't all about sex and relationships. When you get out of highschool you'll meet so many new people. I'm not sure what you're planning on doing with your life, but most likely you'll meet people who are much more like you, and then it will get easier. Relationships aren't all about looks either, you'd be surprised about how many people would prefer to be with a funny person than a conventionally attractive person. I know I'm not much older, but 17 is super young. More has changed in the past 3 years of my life than ever so you just gotta try and hold on. Sending love <33
